newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian shrs climb for fourth day, led by banks.
newsitem.headline: Colombian shrs climb for fourth day, led by banks.

text.p: Colombian stocks rose for the fourth consecutive day, led by banks and other blue chips, brokers said Wednesday.

Bogota's IBB index gained 1.93 percent to end at 894.89 amid a 1.5 billion peso volume, while Medellin's IBOMED general price index edged up up 0.99 percent to end at 13,677.8 amid a 471 million peso trade.

Brokers said there had been renewed interest in stocks since the start of the year when a new government tax on fixed term bond earnings came into effect. The new tax ranges from 1 to 7 percent of earnings depending on the maturity of the bond.
